variants.name: udp
variants.condition: 17 (21 octal) when used in the internet protocol

fields.name: source port
fields.description: port of the sending process. if not used, a value of zero is inserted.

fields.name: destination port
fields.description: port of the destination, meaningful within the context of a particular internet destination address.

fields.name: length

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: one's complement checksum of the pseudo header information.

parsing context.name: ip interface
parsing context.description: udp module must be able to determine source and destination internet addresses and the protocol field from the internet header.

helper functions.name: checksum calculation
helper functions.description: the procedure used to calculate the checksum, same as used in tcp.
